name: Calm breathing-shape loop
description: Create a deliberately calm product-demo or wellness-style ad. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: A quiet expansion/contraction cycle suits the intended message and pacing.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: One simple shape breathes in the center. Four short lines guide the viewer.

props.text: A soft, simple form on a transparent background.

props.label: Benefit
props.placeholder: Two minutes of calm, any time
props.hint: A product benefit, not a health promise.

props.subtitle: Your brand, the invitation and the next step hold.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Calm breathing-shape loop
value.objective: Create a deliberately calm product-demo or wellness-style ad.
value.direction: One clearly observable expansion/contraction cycle carries the experience; the design is quiet rather than empty.
beats: 0–2 s: Friendly simple form and a short invitation are present immediately. Shows Brand color, Calm shape, Invitation.
2–5 s: Form expands slightly around a stable center. Shows Brand color, Calm shape, Breathe in line.
5–8 s: Form returns to its resting size. Shows Brand color, Calm shape, Breathe out line.
8–10 s: Show one supported product benefit, not a health promise. Shows Brand color, Calm shape, Benefit.
10–12 s: Brand, invitation and next step hold. Shows Brand color, Calm shape, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Calm shape
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it.
